Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/942)
Of course it will not make much difference to me whether [‘the Long Vacation](/book/237)’ appears in April or September, so it had better be arranged as you have decided.
I should prefer the [Royalty of /4](/topic/160) on the American Copyright to an immediate sum.[^1]
Might I ask, as I have been before encouraged to do, for a copy of Dean Church’s Life and Letters and also for Sonny Sahib

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The word \'Colonial\' has been substituted in another hand.
